prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS3 mean temperature 37.0 °C (5% below healthy); TS1 mean temperature 40.0 °C (11% above healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 6.44 s (31% below healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 0.0 s (100% below healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.46 l/min (within 2% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 368 W·min/l (4% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.4 % (4% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 12.2 bar (74% below healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.
